epistemic_role: Read-only full frozen-cohort descriptive audit; no new sampling, risk estimate, causal attribution or model selection
question: Across all original stochastic J6B JIT arms, how do no physical commit, later physical transition and last-commit public/hidden readout mismatch overlap, while keeping aborts in the unconditional denominator?

scope.history_indices_per_cell: all original 0..127, exactly 256 independent pre-existing histories
scope.raw_rows: all 2176 original rows mass-balanced, including 128 zero-control rows; exact replay of 2048 stochastic rows, with the 512 JIT rows as descriptive target
scope.seed_rule: master_seed=923240000+100000*cell_index+history_index, cell indices from frozen J6B manifest
scope.flag_semantics: Flags are overlapping observations on scored rows only; later transition and commit mismatch are not applicable after no commit. Failed-closed rows stay in the denominator and are tabulated separately. A physical transition after the last commit is any nonempty transition_edge_faults[last_commit_round:] in the frozen hidden history. Residual uses boundary(physical XOR latest committed full-snapshot correction).
scope.loss: Unchanged stored unconditional Boolean-union logical_failure; no rescore or conditional risk
scope.uncertainty: No new interval, bootstrap, significance test or risk inference; descriptive exact counts only

acceptance: All frozen hashes match before and after; exactly 2176 complete raw rows, 256 stochastic histories and 2048 stochastic arm rows are present with no duplicates; zero controls retain their original rows.

Regenerated 256 existing histories match stored digest, physical, first-observation and second-exogenous keys; all 2048 stochastic arm rows exactly replay under the original public action-conditioned second-record interface, with private truth barred from public requests/actions.

For every scored JIT row, reconstructed commit rounds, bound public second-record digests and independent terminal residual equal the frozen row; failed-closed rows remain unconditional Boolean failures.

Each four-arm cell/mode cohort has 128 rows and its failed-closed/scored-failure/scored-success counts reconcile exactly to D1; overlap masks sum to scored rows. Selected D3 cases retain the same JIT flags. No exclusive mechanism or causal conclusion is drawn.
stop_rule: On any hash, provenance, replay, action-binding, private/public, mass-balance, time or output-cap failure, record a censored result and make no cohort interpretation. Do not adaptively add histories, change scorer, rerun J6/J6B risk analysis or promote selected flags to causes.
claim_boundary: Full frozen-cohort descriptive overlap only, in the phenomenological L=2 five-round model; not an exclusive or causal mechanism ranking, conditional risk, schedule advantage, scaling or threshold.
